author: Progressor I
title: Independent Research: Self-Organizing Systems - Predictive Team Formation with Proactive Balancing (Refined)
abstract: This refined submission addresses the limitations of previous team formation experiments by implementing decaying epsilon-greedy exploration and a stronger, more continuous proactive balancing mechanism in agent decision-making. Agents predict others' final team choices based on their broadcast signals. Each agent then proactively chooses the team that directly contributes to achieving optimal team balance, using a utility function that penalizes deviation from equilibrium. This aims to facilitate robust self-organization into stable and balanced teams, optimizing for sustained collective reward in a dynamic environment over an increased number of rounds (100).
